name: claire-desktop
_comment:productName: Electron derives app.getName() and the userData path from this; without it the scoped package name becomes a literal '@claire/desktop' directory.
description: Claire Desktop — Electron shell hosting the Claire client's web build.

scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run build:preload
scripts._comment:build:preload: A sandboxed preload cannot require() relative modules, so it must ship as one bundled file.
scripts._comment:run: dev and prod are separate apps (name, icon, userData) so they can run at the same time.
scripts.package: bun run bundle:renderer && bun run build && bun run build:push-helper && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:dev: bun run bundle:renderer && bun run build && bun run build:push-helper && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml

author: Claire contributors
